objectives: Describe Abraham's hospitality and leadership toward the three men.
Explain the promise of Isaac and the faith of Sarah and Abraham.
Explain the iniquity of Sodom and Abraham's intercession.
takeaways: The three men were angels with bodies; some have entertained angels unawares.
Is any thing too hard for the Lord? Through faith Sarah conceived past age, and Abraham staggered not at the promise (Hebrews 11:11-12).
The Lord knew Abraham would command his children and household after him to do justice and judgment.
The iniquity of Sodom was pride, fulness of bread, idleness, and abomination (Ezekiel 16:49-50); spiritual Sodom has the same today.
Abraham reasoned from fifty righteous down to ten for Lot's sake; shall not the Judge of all the earth do right?
